summary: ALLOW_JINJA_IN_EXTRA_VARS controls Jinja in job template extra vars: 'Only On Template Definitions' (default, saved vars only, not prompts or surveys), 'Never' (recommended) or 'Always' (strongly discouraged).
questions: Can I use Jinja in survey variables?
Why are my extra vars not templated?

answer_card.title: ALLOW_JINJA_IN_EXTRA_VARS values
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Only On Template Definitions** (default): Jinja allowed only in extra vars saved on the job template; prompted and survey vars excluded
- **Never**: no Jinja (recommended)
- **Always**: always allowed (strongly discouraged)
